method: Lock the post-merge main canonical snapshot before publication and review all 190 June cards across top, high and mid signal tiers.

Re-derive the June thesis from the canonical universe rather than copying the legacy monthly narrative; legacy material existed in the repository and prior context, so this is canonical-first procedural independence rather than an information-blind exercise.
Use legacy June briefs only as a red-team comparison for omissions, inherited framing and overreach after the canonical-first flow draft was formed in this run.
Separate contract, financing, construction, commissioning and commercial operation stages; announced GW/GWh is never treated as installed capacity.
Reject EV-down-to-ESS substitution unless separately proven; ESS growth is treated as an independent demand axis.
Apply a strict SBTL pouch lens: no pouch-film demand inference without form-factor, customer-program or supply-contract evidence.
Require every public reference to preserve the locked canonical title/date and bind to a title-supporting governed URL accepted by the provenance validator.

selected_flows.title: ESS, 용량보다 계약·금융·COD가 자산가치를 결정
selected_flows.reason: Independent June evidence spans tolling, project finance, tax-equity finance, 20-year capacity revenue and COD, showing asset monetization and execution without conflating stages.

selected_flows.title: ESS 수요, 지역·저장시간·조달규모가 함께 넓어짐
selected_flows.reason: Global shipment growth, an operating 8-hour asset, large Chinese OEM offtakes and a 25GWh European framework show simultaneous geographic, duration and procurement-scale expansion.

selected_flows.title: 나트륨·CO₂는 상업계약으로, 전고체는 검증단계가 갈림
selected_flows.reason: Sodium-ion and CO2 storage have delivery/commercial-contract milestones while all-solid-state evidence ranges from road testing to explicit TRL4 caution, making maturity-stage separation decision-relevant.

selected_flows.title: 공급망 규칙, 국가·품목에서 기업·조달 적격성까지 세분화
selected_flows.reason: US and China actions operate at named-company procurement/export-control level while G7 and EU measures add nonbinding coordination and production finance; the regulatory unit is becoming more granular.

selected_flows.title: 현지화, 공장 위치에서 기술·원료·IP 구조로 확장
selected_flows.reason: Ford LFP licensing/test cells, a five-year foil-input contract and LGES patent licensing show localization depends on technology rights, input contracts and IP as well as plant location.

upgrades: AI/data-center framing demoted from a standalone June flow because the stronger cross-market evidence is ESS revenue-contract/finance execution
ESS growth split from ESS monetization so shipment growth is not treated as project execution
technology section reorganized by commercial maturity rather than chemistry list
trade/localization reframed around company-level procurement eligibility and finance conditions
SBTL pouch-film inference explicitly narrowed to verified form-factor/customer evidence
not_carried_forward: Samsung SDI-VW unified-cell report is not used as a public anchor because the card itself flags lack of VW official confirmation

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: AI data centers are the main causal driver of June ESS growth
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: AI-linked evidence exists, but the canonical cross-market pattern is broader: tolling, capacity contracts, financing and grid operation. AI is not required to explain the selected June thesis.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: ESS growth means EV demand has been replaced
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: The official evidence establishes storage growth and contracting, not a one-for-one causal substitution from EV demand.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: China H1 distribution-area ESS filings equal installed capacity
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: The canonical gate explicitly distinguishes filings from construction, commissioning and commercial operation.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: NatPower-Tesla 25GWh and Chinese OEM 659GWh offtakes are delivered installations
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: Both are procurement/offtake indicators; delivery, project finance and installation remain separate execution stages.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: US 1260H listing is a general sanction or investment ban
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: The card explicitly limits the June action to Defense Department procurement restrictions.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: G7 has adopted a binding critical-mineral price floor
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: The June declaration lists price-gap support, joint procurement and price floors as options, not a finalized binding regime.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: Ford Michigan LFP is already in commercial mass production
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: The governed card limits the event to production-intent test cells; customer approval and commercial shipment remain to be verified.

rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.narrative: June ESS/LFP growth directly implies pouch-film demand
rejected_or_narrowed_narratives.reason: The selected June evidence contains no direct pouch-form-factor customer program or pouch-film supply contract.
